question: Which of the following is the oldest tennis tournament in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wimbledon.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• Wimbledon__, is the oldest Grand Slam tennis tournament.
 
• It was started in 1877.
 
• This grass court tennis grand slam is the oldest of all four of these tennis events.
 
• The oldest, still-active tennis tournament in the entire world, it is looked at by many in the tennis world as the most prestigious, and it is usually held from late June to early July.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• There are four Grand Slam tournaments in Tennis viz. Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon and US Open. 
 
• These are the biggest tennis events of the year.
 
• US open
 
 
• It was started in 1881.
 
• It is held annually, starting on the last Monday in August, and lasting for two weeks into September, with the middle weekend coinciding with the Labor Day holiday.
 
• This tournament is played on a hard court.
 
 
 
• French Open
 
 
• It was started in 1891. 
 
• It is also known as the Roland Garros tournament.
 
• It was held over two weeks between late May and early June in Paris.
 
• This tournament is played on clay courts.
 
 
 
• Australian Open
 
 
• It was started in 1905. 
 
• This tournament is held annually in Melbourne over the fortnight of January.
 
• It is played on hard courts. 
 
• The tournament holds the record for the highest attendance at a Grand Slam event.
